+from fastapi import APIRouter, FastAPI

+
+def test_include_router_itself():
+    app = FastAPI()
+    router = APIRouter()

+        return

+import functools
+from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+import pytest
+import asyncio
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+def sync_dep(q: str = "default"):
+    return q
+
+async def async_dep(q: str = "default"):
+    return q
+
+# Partial of a sync function
+partial_sync_dep = functools.partial(sync_dep, q="partial_sync_value")
+# Partial of an async function
+partial_async_dep = functools.partial(async_dep, q="partial_async_value")
+
+@app.get("/sync")
+async def read_sync(dep = Depends(partial_sync_dep)):
+    return {"dep": dep}
+
+@app.get("/async")
+async def read_async(dep = Depends(partial_async_dep)):
+    return {"dep": dep}
+
+class CallableClass:
+    def __call__(self, q: str = "default"):
+        return q
+
+class AsyncCallableClass:
+    async def __call__(self, q: str = "default"):
+        return q
+
+async_callable_instance = AsyncCallableClass()
+partial_async_callable = functools.partial(async_callable_instance, q="partial_async_value")
+
+@app.get("/async-callable")
+async def read_async_callable(dep = Depends(partial_async_callable)):
+    return {"dep": dep}
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+def test_partial_sync_dep():
+    response = client.get("/sync")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {"dep": "partial_sync_value"}
+
+def test_partial_async_dep():
+    response = client.get("/async")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == {"dep": "partial_async_value"}
+

+    assert response.json() == {"dep": "partial_async_value"}
+

+from rich.console import Console
